# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright young woman with fair, curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears very large sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is a sympathetic and ladylike teacher with a sweet voice, possessing the happy gift of winning her pupils' affections and bringing out their best qualities. She is tactful, careful, and broadminded, encouraging her students to explore and think independently.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## Traits

- Bright and sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Tactful and broadminded  <sub>[v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skillful and inspiring teaching  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>
- Physical culture instruction  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To bring out the best in her pupils mentally and morally  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To prepare her advanced students to pass the entrance examination for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as the first female schoolteacher in Avonlea. She introduced new educational methods, including physical culture exercises, nature study field days, bi-weekly recitations, and essay writing. She organized a special class for advanced students who wished to prepare for the Queen's Academy entrance examination. Although offered a teaching position in her home district, she chose to remain in Avonlea to see her students through their entrance exams. Under her guidance, all members of her Queen's class passed their entrance examinations, with Anne Shirley tying for first place. After a farewell at the end of the term, she left Avonlea school.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_

## Background by volume

- She was the first female teacher hired for Avonlea school
